name: Dear...
description: An inventive and cinematic approach to biographies of the most iconic figures in society today by using letters written by those whose lives have been changed through their work.

videos.title: Spike Lee
videos.overview: Lee's film School Daze propels an educator to become the president of a historically black college.

videos.title: Lin-Manuel Miranda
videos.overview: The Hamilton creator inspires a father and daughter to overcome the challenges of fighting cancer.

videos.title: Stevie Wonder
videos.overview: Discovering Wonder's music restores the faith of a woman who woke up blind and helps her reconnect with the world.

videos.title: Oprah Winfrey
videos.overview: Winfrey's trailblazing journey motivates a Georgia man to confront racism and run for elected office in his hometown.

videos.title: Gloria Steinem
videos.overview: A woman is emboldened by Steinem's feminist activism to become a doctor at a time when society expected her to be a homemaker.

videos.title: Big Bird
videos.overview: The beloved Sesame Street Star helps a young Indian American immigrant feel less alone in her new country.

videos.title: Jane Goodall
videos.overview: The animal welfare activist's struggles and triumphs inspire two Balinese teenagers to start a movement of their own.

videos.title: Aly Raisman
videos.overview: The perseverance Raisman displayed in her Olympic quest helps a young gymnast who lost her leg defy the odds.

videos.title: Yara Shahidi
videos.overview: Shahidi's commitment to social justice issues empowers a community organizer who grew up in foster homes to change the system.

videos.title: Misty Copeland
videos.overview: The groundbreaking African American ballerina motivates an aspiring aerospace engineer to triumph over racial and gender boundaries.

videos.title: Viola Davis
videos.overview: The Oscar® winner's advocacy for women of color inspires a Nigerian woman to start an organization to help women and young girls in her country.

videos.title: Sandra Oh
videos.overview: Emboldened by Oh's “it's an honor just to be Asian” proclamation at the Emmys®, a journalist starts an Asian American pride movement.

videos.title: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
videos.overview: An op-ed written by the NBA legend leads a Latino activist to create an organization devoted to uniting communities of color in L.A.

videos.title: Billy Porter
videos.overview: Porter's tireless efforts to break barriers in show business help a fellow stage performer create a platform to celebrate Black actors on Broadway.

videos.title: Jane Fonda
videos.overview: The outspoken activist's TED Talk on life's third act encourages a woman on the verge of 60 to forge ahead in a new career instead of retiring.

videos.title: Ava DuVernay
videos.overview: Inspired by the award-winning director's work, four Black female judges create a nonprofit to educate kids about the criminal justice system.

videos.title: Malala Yousafzai
videos.overview: The Nobel Peace Prize winner meets a young Syrian refugee and inspires her to fight for girls' education and freedom from child marriage.

videos.title: Laird Hamilton
videos.overview: Hamilton's surfing innovations give a triple amputee encouragement to adapt the sport to his body.

videos.title: André Leon Talley
videos.overview: The late fashion editor and style icon who broke long-standing racial barriers mentored an up-and-coming Black designer.

videos.title: Selena Gomez
videos.overview: Selena's honesty about her mental health gives two people the courage to speak out about their own challenges.
